name: 80 Mile PLC
summary: 80 Mile Plc engages in the exploration and development of base metals. It operates through the following geographical segments: Greenland, Finland, and UK. Its project portfolio includes Dundas Ilmenite Project, Disko-Nuussuaq, Kangerluarsuk, and Thunderstone. The company was founded on March 11, 2005, and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.
